FlashAttention computes the same dense attention, up to floating-point rounding, without materializing the full $N\times N$ score/probability matrix in HBM. It loads query/key/value tiles into fast memory and maintains a running row maximum, normalization sum, and weighted value sum. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.14135)

$$m'=\max(m,m_b),\quad \ell'=e^{m-m'}\ell+\sum_j e^{s_j-m'},\quad o'=e^{m-m'}o+\sum_j e^{s_j-m'}v_j.$$

Backward reloads tiles and reconstructs probabilities from saved row normalization statistics and inputs. This spends arithmetic to save memory traffic. FlashAttention-2 improves parallel work partitioning and reduces non-matmul operations. FlashAttention-3 exploits Hopper-specific asynchronous execution and low-precision techniques. [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.08691) [3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08608) Dense attention FLOPs remain quadratic in sequence length; lower IO does not make the algorithm sparse or approximate.
